mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_employee (shop_id, username, password, avatar_url, status) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{username}, #{password}, #{avatarUrl}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_employee WHERE username = #{username} AND shop_id = #{shopId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_employee SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE shop_id = #{shopId}
UPDATE tb_employee SET last_login_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, login_count = login_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_login_logs (user_id, login_ip, login_device, login_location, user_agent, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{ip}, #{device}, #{location}, #{userAgent}, #{status})
